documents.title: USGS ShakeAlert Code Review RFI, Statement of Work

response_due.statement: RFI responses are due by October 16, 2026 at 12:00 PM PST.
response_due.quote: Responses are requested by October 16, 2026 at 12:00pm PST.

submission_method.statement: Submit responses electronically in PDF format via email to the POC.
submission_method.quote: All responses should be submitted electronically in PDF format and emailed

items.statement: Perform a module-by-module review of source code quality, correctness, and maintainability.
items.quote: A rigorous, module-by-module review of source code quality, correctness, and maintainability.

items.statement: Assess current software development and deployment practices with CI/CD pipeline modernization recommendations.
items.quote: An assessment of current software development and deployment practices, with concrete recommendations for modernizing the CI/CD pipeline

items.statement: RFI responses are due by October 16, 2026 at 12:00 PM PST.
items.quote: Responses are requested by October 16, 2026 at 12:00pm PST.

items.statement: Submit responses electronically in PDF format via email to the POC.
items.quote: All responses should be submitted electronically in PDF format and emailed

items.statement: Email responses to [name] at [email].
items.quote: [name] at [email].

items.statement: Email subject line must read “RFI: 140G0326Q0223 – ShakeAlert Production System Code Review.”
items.quote: The subject line of the email should read as follows “RFI: 140G0326Q0223 – ShakeAlert Production System Code Review.”

items.statement: Include applicable socioeconomic designation in the submission.
items.quote: Applicable socioeconomic designation.

items.statement: Include business size standard in the submission.
items.quote: Business size standard.

items.statement: Include SAM UEI number in the submission.
items.quote: SAM UEI number.

items.statement: Include GSA contract number, if applicable.
items.quote: GSA contract number, if applicable.

items.statement: Include ability to execute all listed tasks.
items.quote: Ability to execute all tasks listed.

items.statement: Submit capability statements and general approach/solution for listed requirements.
items.quote: Respondents must submit capability statements and information describing the general approach/solution to addressing the listed requirements.

items.statement: General marketing information or vendor website references are not responsive.
items.quote: General marketing information or reference to vendor web sites will not be considered responsive

items.statement: Telephone, mail, or fax responses will not be accepted.
items.quote: No telephone, mail, or fax responses will be accepted.

items.statement: Perform deep qualitative review of each module for correctness, reliability, multithreading, and real-time safety.
items.quote: The contractor shall perform a deep qualitative review of each module, examining:

items.statement: Assess inter-process interactions, message schemas, and handling of ordering and timing dependencies.
items.quote: Inter-process interactions: correctness of message-passing interfaces (currently ActiveMQ, transitioning to NATS); adherence to defined message schemas

items.statement: Identify all runtime-configurable parameters and document their expected ranges, sensitivity, and default values.
items.quote: identification of all runtime-configurable parameters in each module; documentation of their expected ranges, sensitivity, and default values

items.statement: Review known issues from prior work and assess whether code-level changes could reduce them.
items.quote: review of specific issues identified in prior work (e.g., differences in solutions across server instances due to variations

items.statement: Assess data flow and interface consistency across modules for format, units, coordinate systems, and time references.
items.quote: Data flow and interface consistency: whether module inputs and outputs are consistent in format, units, coordinate systems

items.statement: Review Solution Aggregator logic that merges EPIC, FinDer, and GFAST solutions including edge cases.
items.quote: specific attention to the Solution Aggregator (SA) logic that merges EPIC, FinDer, and GFAST solutions

items.statement: Review Decision Module logic used to determine if ShakeAlert Message should be published.
items.quote: review of the Decision Module (DM) logic used to determine if ShakeAlert Message should be published

items.statement: Review alert-pause feature and alert-update thresholds with attention to the 2022 Ferndale earthquake bug case.
items.quote: review of the alert-pause feature and alert-update thresholds for correctness, with attention to the 2022 Ferndale earthquake bug case

items.statement: Review GitLab repository structure, branching strategy, merge request process, and tagging/versioning practices.
items.quote: The contractor shall review the current GitLab repository structure, branching strategy, merge request process, and tagging/versioning practices

items.statement: Recommend specific static open-source analysis tools compatible with the ShakeAlert code base.
items.quote: The contractor shall recommend specific static open-source analysis tools compatible with the ShakeAlert code base

items.statement: Implement at least a baseline CI/CD pipeline configuration in the project’s GitLab repository as Deliverable 6.
items.quote: The contractor shall implement at least a baseline CI/CD pipeline configuration in the project’s GitLab repository as part of Deliverable 6

items.statement: Review existing coding standards documentation, assess compliance, and recommend a concise, enforceable coding standard.
items.quote: The contractor shall review the project’s existing coding standards documentation (if any), assess compliance across the code base

items.statement: Review current deployment process and assess reproducibility, rollback capability, configuration management, and deployment testing.
items.quote: The contractor shall review the current deployment process (Ansible and related tooling) and assess:

items.statement: Review all production modules listed in scope plus modified Earthworm modules and third-party libraries.
items.quote: The contractor shall review all of the following production modules, plus any Earthworm modules and third-party libraries

items.statement: Review work must be based on the production branch of code at repository access time.
items.quote: All review work shall be based on the production branch of the code at the time of repository access

items.statement: Contractor must request and document design intent, known limitations, and open issues for each module.
items.quote: The contractor shall request and document, for each module, the design intent, known limitations, and any open issues

items.statement: Contractor must communicate findings progressively, not only in final reports.
items.quote: The contractor shall communicate findings to USGS ShakeAlert staff progressively (not only in final reports)

items.statement: Primary recommendations must be technically sound, linked to deficiencies, and actionable within program constraints.
items.quote: Primary recommendations shall be technically sound, clearly linked to identified deficiencies, and actionable within the constraints

items.statement: Avoid recommendations requiring complete rewrite of major modules unless compelling justification exists.
items.quote: Recommendations that require a complete rewrite of major modules are unlikely to be actionable and should be avoided

items.statement: Recommendations on inter-process communication must remain valid under anticipated NATS architecture or address both states.
items.quote: Recommendations related to inter-process communication shall be written to remain valid under the anticipated NATS architecture

items.statement: Apply MISRA C/C++ guidelines or equivalent as reference framework for code review.
items.quote: MISRA C/C++ guidelines (or equivalent; to be agreed at kickoff based on language profile of code base)

items.statement: Apply CERT C/C++ Secure Coding Standard for security-relevant findings.
items.quote: CERT C/C++ Secure Coding Standard for security-relevant findings

items.statement: Apply SEI CERT guidelines for concurrency and real-time considerations.
items.quote: SEI CERT guidelines for concurrency and real-time considerations

items.statement: Apply federal government IT security and software assurance guidance relevant to USGS systems.
items.quote: Federal government IT security and software assurance guidance relevant to USGS systems

items.statement: Agree on specific standards and tools at kickoff based on languages and build environment.
items.quote: At kickoff, the contractor and USGS shall agree on the specific standards and tools to be applied

items.statement: Contractor must acknowledge understanding of Intellectual Property rules governing ShakeAlert production code.
items.quote: The contractor shall acknowledge they understand the Intellectual Property rules which govern the ShakeAlert production code

items.statement: Participate in kickoff meeting within 30 days of contract award.
items.quote: The contractor shall participate in a kickoff meeting (in person or virtual) within 30 days of contract award

items.statement: Hold at least monthly progress meetings with USGS ShakeAlert technical staff throughout contract period.
items.quote: The contractor shall hold at least monthly progress meetings with USGS ShakeAlert technical staff throughout the contract period

items.statement: Submit contractor questions in writing or capture them in meeting minutes to create a record.
items.quote: Contractor questions shall be submitted in writing (e.g. email or issue tracker) or captured in meeting minutes

items.statement: All written reports must be submitted in both PDF and editable Word (.docx) format.
items.quote: All written reports shall be submitted in both PDF and editable Word (.docx) format

items.statement: Address USGS comments within 30 days of their review.
items.quote: the contractor shall address USGS comments within 30 days thereafter

items.statement: Deliver kickoff meeting and work plan in Month 1.
items.quote: Kickoff meeting and work plan      Month 1                    Meeting + written plan

items.statement: Deliver code metrics baseline report for all modules in Month 3.
items.quote: Code metrics baseline report       Month 3                    Written report + data files

items.statement: Deliver detailed code review findings for all modules in Month 6.
items.quote: Detailed code review findings      Month 6                    Written report with prioritized

items.statement: Deliver CI/CD and development practices assessment in Month 8.
items.quote: CI/CD and development              Month 8                    Written report with

items.statement: Deliver final report and recommendations in Month 11.
items.quote: Final report and                   Month 11                   Comprehensive report; briefing

items.statement: Demonstrate CI/CD improvements in repository by Month 12.
items.quote: Demonstration of CI/CD             Month 12                   Working pipeline changes in

items.statement: Conduct kickoff meeting and deliver written work plan within 30 days of award.
items.quote: Within 30 days of contract award, the contractor shall conduct a kickoff meeting with USGS ShakeAlert technical staff and deliver a written work plan

items.statement: Work plan must specify review methodology, tools, standards, task schedule, POCs, and communication plan.
items.quote: deliver a written work plan that specifies the review methodology, tools and standards to be applied, task schedule with milestones, points of contact

items.statement: Deliver quantitative code metrics baseline report covering all modules in Section 4.
items.quote: A quantitative characterization of the code base covering all modules in Section 4. The report shall include per-module and aggregate metrics

items.statement: Metrics report must include LOC, cyclomatic complexity, Halstead metrics, test coverage, and documentation coverage.
items.quote: The report shall include per-module and aggregate metrics (LOC, cyclomatic complexity, Halstead metrics, test coverage, documentation coverage), a dependency graph

items.statement: Metrics report must include dependency graph and prioritized list of modules flagged for deeper review.
items.quote: a dependency graph, and a prioritized list of modules and subsystems flagged for deeper review based on the metrics

items.statement: Raw metric data must be provided as machine-readable files (CSV or JSON).
items.quote: Raw metric data shall be provided as machine-readable files (e.g., CSV or JSON) in addition to the narrative report

items.statement: Deliver module-by-module code review report organized by Section 3.1.2 review dimensions.
items.quote: A module-by-module code review report organized by the review dimensions in Section 3.1.2

items.statement: Each finding must identify affected module/file, describe issue/impact, assign severity rating, and provide recommendation.
items.quote: For each finding, the report shall identify the affected module and file, describe the issue and its potential impact on alert reliability or correctness

items.statement: Findings must include consolidated findings table for prioritization.
items.quote: The report shall include a consolidated findings table for easy prioritization

items.statement: Critical and High severity findings must include proposed code changes where practical.
items.quote: Critical and High severity findings shall include proposed code changes (pseudocode or actual code) where practical

items.statement: Deliver CI/CD and development practices assessment report covering GitLab workflow, static analysis, coding standards, deployment.
items.quote: A report covering the assessment of GitLab workflow, automated static analysis tooling, coding standards, and deployment practices described in Section 3.2

items.statement: CI/CD assessment must describe current practice, identify gaps, and provide prioritized recommendations with effort estimates.
items.quote: For each area, the report shall describe current practice, identify gaps relative to applicable standards and industry practice, and provide prioritized

items.statement: CI/CD assessment must include step-by-step implementation guide for recommended pipeline improvements.
items.quote: The report shall include a step-by-step implementation guide for the recommended CI/CD pipeline improvements

items.statement: Deliver comprehensive final report synthesizing findings with prioritized action plan and executive summary.
items.quote: A comprehensive final report that synthesizes findings across all tasks, highlights the most impactful improvements, and provides a recommended prioritized action plan

items.statement: Final report must include executive summary suitable for non-technical stakeholders.
items.quote: The report shall include an executive summary suitable for non-technical stakeholders

items.statement: Present findings to ShakeAlert staff and program management in virtual briefing of approximately two hours.
items.quote: The contractor shall present the findings to ShakeAlert technical staff and program management in a virtual briefing of approximately two hours

items.statement: Implement working CI/CD configuration changes in ShakeAlert GitLab repository, reviewed and approved by USGS.
items.quote: Working CI/CD configuration changes implemented in the ShakeAlert GitLab repository, reviewed and approved by USGS

items.statement: CI/CD pipeline must automate build verification, static analysis, unit test execution, and coverage reporting on every merge request.
items.quote: that automate at a minimum: build verification, static analysis (linting and complexity checks), unit test execution, and coverage reporting on every merge request

items.statement: Document pipeline configuration and provide brief user guide for ShakeAlert staff.
items.quote: The contractor shall document the pipeline configuration and provide a brief user guide for ShakeAlert staff

items.statement: Period of performance is 12 months from date of contract award.
items.quote: Period of performance: 12 months from date of contract award

items.statement: All work may be performed remotely; travel to USGS facilities is not required.
items.quote: All work may be performed remotely. Travel to USGS facilities is not required but may be proposed by the contractor

items.statement: Treat all non-public ShakeAlert code, configuration, and documentation as sensitive; do not disclose to third parties.
items.quote: The contractor shall treat all non-public ShakeAlert code, configuration, and documentation as sensitive and shall not disclose it to third parties

items.statement: NDA or comparable instrument will be executed at contract award.
items.quote: A non-disclosure agreement (NDA) or comparable instrument will be executed at contract award

items.statement: Contractor is not expected to implement code fixes; that responsibility remains with USGS staff.
items.quote: The contractor is not expected to implement code fixes; that responsibility remains with USGS staff

items.statement: Exception: contractor will implement CI/CD pipeline changes in repository under USGS review (Deliverable 6).
items.quote: The exception is Deliverable 6, where the contractor will implement CI/CD pipeline changes in the repository under USGS review

items.statement: All recommendations shall consider USGS strong preference to use open-source code, libraries, and tools.
items.quote: All recommendations shall consider the strong preference of USGS to use open-source code, libraries, and tools

items.statement: Contractor personnel performing code review shall have demonstrated experience in real-time or safety-critical software systems.
items.quote: Contractor personnel performing the code review shall have demonstrated experience in real-time or safety-critical software systems

items.statement: Relevant domain experience in seismology or geophysical data processing is desirable but not required.
items.quote: Relevant domain experience in seismology or geophysical data processing is desirable but not required
